title: Iceologer Mod
description:
This Mod Adds The Iceologer From Minecraft Dungeons to minecraft

it also drops ice

you can configure the mod with these gamerules

Gamerule: DropIceChunks: a Boolean value rather if the Iceologer will drop ice chunks

theres one other gamerule cant fit.
body:
**Moderators if you think i am missing a step of verification just tell me what i am missing**

This Mod Adds The **Iceologer** From Minecraft Dungeons to Minecraft

it also drops ice

you can configure the mod with these gamerules

Gamerule: DropIceChunks: a Boolean value rather if the **Iceologer** will drop ice chunks

Gamerule: iceologerTurnsBlocksTouchedWhenFallingIntoIce: a Boolean value rather if the **Iceologer** will place a ice block when landed
